Results.ReviewText: Weber provided a fast, hassle free replacement part for my grill. The easiest and friendliest customer service I have ever experienced!
Results.Title: Great Customer service!

Results.ReviewText: Recently bought this online with Amazon. Arrived in perfect condition. We cleaned grills first as a precaution. All parts were included and easy to set up. Used it right away following instructions on temps and process. Had a nice Cajun Grilled Shrimp dinner to enjoy! Worked perfect! Temps were accurate and cooked correctly. Cleaned easily afterward. The grill is high quality as expected. I have used WEBER  grills for years and have never been disappointed. Highly recommend this unit as a portable option for picnics and for use in a condo setting. I believe it is as versatile as a grill can be, just smaller in size than the backyard versions.
Results.Title: A true Mighty Mite gas grill

Results.ReviewText: Just a superb product! Salmon, steak, kabobs all cooked perfectly. Easy clean up!
Results.Title: Perfect Grill for Two Home or Away

Results.ReviewText: Bought this for camping.  Heats fast and cooks evenly.  Added a quick release fitting and now connect directly to my campers gas, easy conversion.  Also got the half griddle top, works terrific for cooking eggs or pancakes. Wing shelves could be a little stiffer.
Results.Title: Great For Camping

Results.ReviewText: Can’t say enough about this little grill.  I bought it to use for tailgating during rugby season and it is perfect!  Easy to use right out of the box.  Heats up to 400 degrees in less than 15 minutes.  Weber has done it again
Results.Title: Perfect tailgate

Results.ReviewText: Nice grill for two people. Takes up very little space on our small camper and heats evenly.  Be sure to get the griddle for making breakfast.   I have cooked for a small group both breakfast and dinner with very little delay.
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill; perfect for two people, can do duty for four in pinch. Sits tight and stable on the optional stand. Appreciate the color options. Can’t comment yet on fuel economy (only had it for four weeks, and I’m estimating I’ve used up one 16 oz container for some 8 (or 9) grill sessions.
Results.Title: Great grill for small household

Results.ReviewText: This grill is the second one that we have purchased.  Our first grill lasted over 8 years having cooked and prepared many delicious meals.  Even with regular cleaning and attention, parts began to wear out.  So, when it came time to replace it, getting another unit was a "no brainer".  It is compact and meets all our of grilling needs.  We also purchased the wheeled grill stand on which it sits and this unit allows us to move it from one location to another.  This compact unit is a gem for us retired folks.
Results.Title: Worth the investment!

Results.ReviewText: There is never been a more reliable grill. We have had one for 15 years and just got another one to put in another house that we have. The one that’s 15 years old still works like a champ! And no rust!
Results.Title: Will last forever

Results.ReviewText: First Weber we have had. Cook’s great, easy to clean, easy to control heat
Results.Title: First Wber

Results.ReviewText: We love our new Weber BBQ.  We have always purchased Weber's as they are the most dependable brand out there!!  This is replacing our 40-year-old small camping Weber.  We love the additional grill space on this one and it cooks so fast!!!
Results.Title: A fantastic new upgrade to our camping BBQ

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber Q grill and it performs as well as my first one
Results.Title: Happy Repeat Customer

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is important to us. We are sorry to hear that the regulator has failed in your grill. We are constantly working on ways to improve our products, and we will pass your feedback along to the right team. We want to learn more about your experience. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: I bought this model largely on the strength of the brand name, as well as the table-top size.  The results have been mixed, and my rating could just as easily be two stars as three.  It worked well, but the regulator lasted only about 10-12 uses, requiring me to get a new one from Weber.  Fortunately the grill was one month within its warranty period so they sent me one for free, but the Internet is full of bad comments about this exact problem so it is likely one of inherent design and build.  In other words, this is not a reliable grill for long-term service right out of the box.  If I were a Weber executive this fact would frighten me to death.  Because of the early failure of the regular, I no longer have respect for Weber gas grills and will likely look elsewhere for my next model.  That is a real shame.  What griller has not seen or used a Weber kettle somewhere?  I suspect that the grill parts (all or some) are no longer made in the U.S.A. and have used cheap materials and construction to keep costs down.  This will kill Weber in the long run.  I hope this new regulator that I installed will work for a long time.  I wish I had the confidence to say that I think it will.  Sadly, I think my experience is one of many such experiences, and is likely the tip of the iceberg that will sink what I once thought was the best brand out there.
Results.Title: Can Weber Right the Ship??

Results.ReviewText: Small, portable, easy start , cooks evenly , easy to clean
Results.Title: Love my Weber Q1200 grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber makes the best grills! I purchased this one for road trips
Results.Title: Love my Weber

Results.ReviewText: Have only used my Weber grill a couple of times, but find it a very good little barbecue. We purchased this to replace the old bbq in our travel trailer. We needed something small to keep in the trailer and with recommendations from relatives, we got the Weber. It is a heavy bbq, but the casting holds heat better than the stamped tin ones. So far I love the Weber bbq and will probably use it at home as well.
Results.Title: Trailer bbq

Results.ReviewText: We love our new Weber Grill! It’s very portable, easy to start, easy to clean, and cooks evenly!
Results.Title: Great little grill!

Results.ReviewText: Very nice grill use it at camp at seasonal works great.!!
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Best portable bbq i ever had wish It came with the stand or could buy it /find it cheaper in my town I recommend it to anyone looking for a small bbq for apartments or traveling
Results.Title: Best portable i ever bought

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback and are sorry to hear about your disappointing experience with the grill. Our Care Team will reach out to help. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: I received my 1200 Q liquid propane grill purchased at Home Depot as promised in good condition. Once assembled I tried to attach a bottle of gas to the grill but it hit the handle and would not attach. I had to drill another hole in mounting bracket to make it work ( poor quality control for a Weber product). Once this was accomplished I decided to cook with it. Temperature control is not very responsive, it cooks extremely hot. Even in lowest setting grill temp. Is still over 300 degrees. That’s ok for general grilling but to cook  low and slow will be impossible. To pay $260.00 for a table top grill and not be able to cook like you want with it is questionable. Overall degree of satisfaction is about a 3.
Results.Title: Little green Q 1200

Results.ReviewText: Great heat. This is our second one. Beautiful char marks. Can definitely do steaks. Easy to clean. Heats quickly and evenly. Canisters last a few times, since it heats up so fast.
Results.Title: Best Small Grill Ever

Results.ReviewText: This is my second weber grill and  both have been great. Simple to operate and cook nicely. EXCEPT this one developed a leak at the regulator and the process of getting a replacement under warrenty was terribly difficult and frustrating. The dealer I bought it from had closed, so the company website was my only recourse. Dealing with an AI system that asked questions already answered and refused to believe my answers. Finally another local dealer helped me produce a video to prove the problem was as I described it and, once that was done, i did get the replacement part promptly.
Results.Title: Great grill. Difficult warrenty process

Results.ReviewText:
Had a Weber 1000 and had an issue with the regulator after a number of years. Replaced it with a different bbq and the thing was always on fire from the grease. 
Bought this blue 1200 and I’m so happy to have this bbq. No fire - grease drips out the bottom.
Results.Title: I love this BBQ

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Q grill my first one lasted me 20 years, May it RIP.
Results.Title: Thank you Weber

Results.ReviewText: Easy, convenient, and easy to use!  Perfect for camping!
Results.Title: Perfect for camping

Results.ReviewText: Completely satisfied except that heat only reaches 325 degrees maximum.
Results.Title: Weber grill review.

Results.ReviewText: Great portable grill. I have used on the tailgate several times and will have it in the camper for the next trip. I prefer the cast iron grates over the stainless, due to heat retention and ease of cleaning. The little grill does struggle in the wind, just takes a little more time and ignition is difficult, I try to stand between the wind and the grill at ignition.
Results.Title: Good portable grill

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill. This is our second. The first one lasted 20 years. It would be working still if it hadn’t gotten broken. You can’t go wrong with a Weber. With all the new fangled companies out there today. I still trust one of the oldest outdoor cooking companies in the USA.
Results.Title: You can’t go wrong with a “Q”

Results.ReviewText: I have a Q1200 i bought for rv travel. I bought a folding table that accommodates the q1200 as well. I just returned home from a 7 day excursion where i used the grill 3 times. It cooks very well and is easy to clean and store in the rv storage area. I love the grill. It is definitely fit for purpose. I also purchased a 12’ hose with quick connect for gas supply, i attach to rv for easy use and dont have to have extra gas bottles. All good on my side. Thanks
Results.Title: Q1200

Results.ReviewText: Grill is great, I do wish it had the ability to lock the lid closed to make mobility easier.
Results.Title: Great, but improvements could be made.

Results.ReviewText: After my review expressing disappointment in the cleaning of our Q1200, customer service reached out and asked “Did you know” we have a brush specially made for this grill and a cleaner to spray on the grill?  FYI i they work great!  My grill is easily cleaned now!
Results.Title: Now thats Customer Service!

Results.ReviewText: This is the perfect size for what we need -- it is just the two of us and it is great !
Results.Title: GRILLING GOOD

Results.ReviewText: This is the best little grill I’ve ever owned. Very well built, perfect size for one or two people. And it’s completely portable. Since it’s cast iron, it’s not cheaply made and cleans up easy. The throw away drip pans are genius!
Results.Title: Best little grill in Michigan!

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We're sorry to hear the grill is not getting hot. Our Care Team will reach out to assist in resolving this issue. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Compact but not very powerful. I was looking for a grill to replace my genisis and have had good lluck with Weber products in the past. I wanted something that I cold easily store veritically and then pop open for a quick grilling. This came highly recommended by a friend, but I am so far disappointed with the heat. It takes forever to heat up to 350 degrees and once you open the lid you that heat up time restarts and is much slower once food is on the grill. I cannot keep the grill hot. I am super disappointed and would not recommend. You cannot cook with the lid open as there is little to no heat for searing.
Results.Title: Coldest grill I've ever had

Results.ReviewText: I really love this little grill!  I'm single and it's great for small meals. I like the way it preheats, and the grates are easy to clean. My only complaint is that I can't get it to maintain a medium temperature (350 degrees) with the lid closed. I reduced the gas flow to the grill and turned the temperature to low, but it still creeps up to 400 which is too hot for barbecued chicken or anything that takes longer to cook. I have to keep a close eye and lift the lid to cool it off. Other than that, it's pretty much perfect!
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: My Weber came with a little broken part.  They were wonderful and sent a replacement part quickly.  I am a very happy Weber Griller.
Results.Title: Problem Solved

Results.ReviewText: It's a great little portable grill. But don't let the size fool you, you can easily cook 4 to 6 ribeye steaks at once. The temperature gauge is easily to control and you can really get some high heat to get some good sear on those steaks. A downside is it is heavy, but it is heavy duty and will retain heat very well. The push button start is a one push start. Temperature control with the turn of a knob makes temperature changes quick and easy. The crates are also heavy duty I will leave a great cooking work on your food. The only downside is that you don't have dual burner control, meaning you can't indirectly cook. Save up the extra money because you will want the extra attachments such as a stand or the flat grill.
Results.Title: All around small and Powerful

Results.ReviewText: Works great. Easy to use and clean. Great size for our needs.
Results.Title: Q1200

Results.ReviewText: Now that are family is grown the size is just right for the two of us. Love our little grills. Have one for our deck and one for camping.
Results.Title: Perfect grill for two

Results.ReviewText: When on low temp is around 400. Can’t cook low and slow. Good for steaks but not ribs.
Results.Title: Nice for steaks
